==Ingredients==

*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] black [[Cookbook:Grape|grapes]]
*1 cup fresh curd (thick plain Indian [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]])
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*6 ice cubes
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==

#[[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] black grapes, sugar, curd, milk, and salt in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth.
#Crush ice-cubes, divide it into 4 portions, and divide between 4 glasses.
#Pour the lassi over the ice cubes.
#Serve chilled.
